# CHINNI MALLIKARJUNA AND COMPANY (CMK & Co.)
> Premier Chartered Accountants & Financial Advisory Firm in Chennai, India.
> Official Website: [https://www.cmkca.com](https://www.cmkca.com)

## Firm Overview
[CHINNI MALLIKARJUNA AND COMPANY](https://www.cmkca.com/) is a leading Chartered Accountants (CA) firm located in Velachery, Chennai, Tamil Nadu. The firm provides corporate compliance, statutory auditing, GST & direct tax consulting, business setup & incorporation, NRI taxation, valuation, and financial advisory services.

## Core Specializations & Offerings
- [Business Setup & Incorporation](https://www.cmkca.com/services/): Private Limited Company, LLP, OPC, Section 8 Non-Profit, Partnership Firm, Sole Proprietorship, Indian Subsidiary of foreign entity.
- [Taxation & Advisory](https://www.cmkca.com/services/): Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing, Tax Litigation & Appeals, Scrutiny Assessment defense, International Taxation & Transfer Pricing, NRI Tax Advisory, TDS Returns.
- [GST Compliance](https://www.cmkca.com/services/): GST Registration, Monthly & Quarterly GST Returns, GST Audits, GST Refund Processing, E-Way Bill advisory.
- [Corporate Law & Compliance](https://www.cmkca.com/services/): Annual ROC Filings, Director KYC, ESOP Structuring, FEMA & FDI Filings, Joint Ventures & Mergers/Acquisitions.
- [Audits & Financial Assurance](https://www.cmkca.com/services/): Statutory Audits, Tax Audits, Internal Audits, Cost Audits, Due Diligence.
- [Financial Advisory & Project Funding](https://www.cmkca.com/services/): CMA Reports, Bank Loan Project Reports, Loan Syndication, Business Valuation, Virtual CFO Services.
